main_text.l: EXHORTARI posse, Dei donum est. Rom. 12. 8. Exhortandi inuicem sumus per singulos dies ad fidem in Christum, Heb. 3. 13. Col. 3. 16.

EXHORTATIO pars Prophetiæ, 1. Corinth. 14. 3. Exhortationes doctrinam sequi debent, Rom. 6. v. 11. 12. & 8. v. 11. 12, 1. Corinth. 9. 24. piis sunt necessariæ, 2. Corint. 6. 1. & 13. 10. Ephes. 4. 25. Philip. 4. 1. 1. Thess. 2. 12. & 3. 2. 1. Tim. 4. 12. & 6. 2. 2. Tim. 3. 16. & 4. 2. Tit. 1. 9. & 2. v. 1. 15. Heb. 3. 12. & 13. v. 16. 22. 1. Petr. 1. 13. 2. Petr. 3. 1. 1. Ioan. 2. 12. & 4. 7. & 5. 19. Exhortationum bonarum exempla: Dominus Deus omnipotens, Genes. 4. v. 6. 7. Loth. 19. 7. Rebecca, 27. v. 9. 43. Ruben, 37. 42. soror Mosis, Exodi 2. v. 7. 8. Iethro, 18. 21. Abigail, 1. Sam. 25. v. 24. 25. 26. 32. Abner, 2. Sam. 2. 21. Aggæus & Zacharias, 1. Esd. 5. 1. Abdemelech. Ierem. 38. v. 9. 10. Vide CONSILII boni exempla: & PRAEDICATIO. Exhortationis pij regis ad populum exempla: Iosaphat, 2. Paral. 20. v. 20. 21. Ezechias, 32. 7.
EXIRE & introire, Vide INGREDI & EGREDI. Exitus pro morte, Luc. 9. 31.

EXORCISTAE vocabantur, qui Dæmones eiiciebant, addita per Dei nomen obtestatione, quam vulgò Coniurationem vocant. Vide ADIVRARE. Exorcistæ tempore Pauli, Act. 19. 13. quos fidei expertes diabolus vulnerat.

EXPIATIONIS aqua, dicitur aqua peccati, Num. 8. 7. eò quòd adhiberetur ad expiandum peccatum, quę quomodo confici deberet, præscribitur, 19. 1. &c. [Expiationis hostia, Exod. 29. 36. Leuit. 1. 4. & 16. 30.] Expiatio iuramenti & aliorum peccatorum, Leuit. 5. 1. &c. Num. 5. 6. Sanctuarij, Tabernaculi, Altaris, Leui. 16. v. 14. 16. 18. Expiationum dies 23. 27. Expiationum festum, 16. v. 29. 30.

EXPLORATORES terræ Chanaan, Numer. 13. 3. Deuter. 1. 22, Exploratores mittuntur Ierichunta, Ios. 2. 1. &c. Rahab meretricis hospitio excipiuntur, v. 4. ab ea occultantur, v. 6. per fenestram funę salui demittuntur, vers. 15. [Heb. 11. 31.] Rahab hospitam ex incendio urbis Ierichuntinæ liberant, 6. v. 23. Exploratores terræ promissionis moriuntur omnes, præter Caleb & Iosue, Num. 14. v. 36. 37. V. horum constantiam v. 6. &c. Exploratur Hai, Ios. 7. 2.

EXPOSTVLATIO: Expostulationis exempla: Pharao, Genesis 12. 18. Abimelech, 20. 9. Iacob, 29. 25. & 31. 36. Dauid, 1. Sam. 20. 1. Psalm. 82. 2. Ioab, 2. Sam 14. 31. Nehemias, Nehe. 13. 11. Dominus Deus omnipotens, Ierem. 2. 5. quidam ex Circumcisione,
